summary: M&T Bank Corp filed a Rule 424(b)(5) prospectus supplement dated September 22, 2026, adding Senior Medium-Term Notes, Series C, and Subordinated Medium-Term Notes, Series D to its shelf registration (No. 333-299064) for offerings due nine months or more from issuance. Terms — price, coupon, maturity and currency — will be set in later pricing supplements; notes are unsecured, may be fixed, floating or fixed-to-floating, and are not FDIC-insured. This is a routine debt shelf takedown mechanism, not a special situation; watch for actual pricing supplements disclosing size and spreads.
